narrative.details:
You look like a capable adventurer. Do you happen to be headed towards Shadowgale Forest? Ban'aethal lies deep in the forest; that's where we're all from.

<Ealaane gestures to the other refugees.>

We've recently had to evacuate Ban'aethal, as it began to fall into the sky. It was sudden and in the middle of the night. If you are headed that way, would you please look for any belongings left behind? The forest and village are far too dangerous for us to return to now.
narrative.objectives: Collect 8 Abandoned Belongings from the ruins of Ban'aethal.
narrative.offerRewardText: Thank you, champion, you have done a great kindness to us refugees this day. I will make sure to return these to their owners. At least it gives us a place to start over from.
narrative.requestItemsText: So many of us left with nothing more than the clothes on our backs. Any belongings you might recover would be cherished.

mentionedItems.name: Abandoned Belongings
tooltip: "Crates and baskets with half-packed belongings falling out of them. Whoever gathered this left in a hurry."
